title: Review-station lens finding set (WI-382)
description: The schema-forced StructuredOutput each read-only review lens (subagent) returns to the post-exec parallel review station. The orchestrator NEVER re-parses free text (workflow-fanout-protocol.md): lenses emit this shape, scripts/review-station-merge.mjs merges it mechanically.

lens_id.description: Stable lens identity used for keyed re-review (AC1). One of: g5-auditor, codex-adversarial, audit-testing, audit-security, audit-data-migration, audit-performance, visual-lens (or a registered extension).

never_gate.description: true for security / data-migration lenses — their findings stay keyed for fix re-review regardless of severity (NEVER_GATE coverage preserved).

rounds_used.description: Iteration rounds this lens has consumed. Per-lens cap is 3 and INDEPENDENT — never a single merged counter (AC2).

file.description: repo-relative path the finding is at

line.description: line number (the dedup key is file:line)

evidence.description: why it is real (cite the diff)
